reviews.t: This is fun and also challenging!
reviews.x: There is a pretty big learning curve when using this for the first time. Some things I did that made it easier:  1. You need Vaseline to help mold when it’s on your skin. It says this in the instructions but I had to buy some. 2. If you are doing something like a scar similar to the look I did, I found it easier to mold the wax and adhere it first. Then, use setting powder to hold it in place. Lastly, you can use the pointed end of the tool that is provided to “slice” and make it look real. If y

So i wrote a bad review earlier about it coming without a spatula. And out of nowhere i get another package with a nice card written with an apology about the missing piece and they replaced the entire set with a spatula and another scar wax box.that was really amazing.thank you so much the wax is perfect and spatula is incredible!u care about ur customers and it shows!
I forgot scar wax is bad for high movement parts of your body but other than my own mistake it's a good product

I used this product to make fake wounds. Works really well. It’s very user friendly, super easy to blend and mold. Also I have super sensitive skin and I had no problem with this product, if that helps anyone.
I got this for my daughter for Christmas. She loves to do FX makeup. She said it is very easy to use and lasts a long time. It sticks to itself really well and the spatula that is comes with is nice.
Good quality and easy to work with. I did great for the first time trying.

When I first saw it I tough it wasn’t going to match my skin color because it’s a little bit darker but when you apply it to your skin it matches perfectly you can see how it gets use to your color and super fun to work with this product super thick but also super smooth to work with I loved it 🤍 definitely approved.
I bought this for deep scars that makes it disappear.

Absolute garbage! I tried using it to blend the base of some horns into my skin but this crap is so sticky, it's impossible to use. I tried using baby powder to not have it stick to my fingers but that didnt work. If this crap gets on your clothing, theres no getting it out. This stuff DOES NOT COME OFF!

My daughter is obsessed with doing SFX makeup! She had another brand and it was good but she wanted to try something else. We came across this on Amazon and thought she could give it a shot. She said it’s great!! Better then the others she has used. 10/10 recommend!
It is really moldable and easy to use, however I didn't get a spatula with it! I'm really sad about that, considering I have makeup competition coming up soon.
I like the product. I don’t like that it advertised a spatula but my order didn’t come with one. That would make using it much easier.

Love this product! As an aspiring SFX makeup artist and my first time using scar wax this was very easy to use and is extremely easy to remove. It is so much fun to work with and a little bit goes a long way! The tool that comes with the product is very nice and helps a lot with application. You can easily blend and form the wax with your fingers as well.

I love it. I just used it along with colgated blood which i also found on here. It was fake don't worry, but the wax was perfect. Just know when you put it on use a lil lotion to make it softer and more smooth. And thank god for that stick that comes with it. Over all its pretty amazing i hope this helps.

My Daughter loved this product. We had purchased another earlier in the year but she didn't like it so I purchased this scar wax and it turned out great. I would definitely recommend this product. It is easy to use and easy to remove.
I am very happy with this purchase. I’m new to the scar wax game and it was pretty easy to work with! I would definitely buy this again!
This stuff worked great for my Halloween costume but missed the part I needed to order other products to make it work properly.

Item arrived when I was promised, but the inner packaging for the wax was damaged. As the photo shows, the box holding the container was broken, and the container itself was broken. A piece of cardboard from the box had fallen into the wax. I was able to remove the wax easily, and I've put it into an empty Altoids tin. I don't think the wax itself is damaged, so I'm only docking this one star. I've not yet used it (and can't return it as I need it for this weekend), so I can't speak to how well

We thought this container would be much larger (from the description on Amazon). Also, it's for Halloween so we don't know yet if it will really work all by itself.  It seems to need something called 'spirit gum' to stick well to skin.  That was not clear either.  We are trying to figure out what 'spirit gum' is and where to get some.

I think this is a must have staple for special effects make up kits. I recently stated experimenting with liquid latex and found this molding wax to be a Godsend. Its easy to work with and versatile for experimentation, I love the spatula and you can't beat the price, I highly recommend

The product works great! However, I suggest putting a layer of latex under it first so you can easily peel and remove when needed. The wax was difficult to remove which is normal so I'm not complaining, just a tip to make the process easier! Awesome product!

Any warmth (think skin), softens it and it falls off…. Even with added glue. Spent hours on a costume for Halloween, went out less than an hour and came home because the parts were falling off. Had a great costume planned, but couldn’t last till the judging

This product takes some time to get used to and is somewhat difficult to work with because it was so tacky. It might have just been how I used it??? Pros - you get a lot of the product and a nifty tool. The makeup I used stuck to the putty which was great!

Daughter had fun playing with wax and creating different looks. But she needed another product to wear under it and we couldn’t find any anywhere so she wound up creating her look with contouring and shading and didn’t even use the wax on Halloween.

This was fantastic. My daughter used it to create spooky faces on the elementary kids for their fall haunted hallway. Their gashes looked so real! It is very easy to clean off as well.  Great product and very easy to use!

claims.text: Most reviewers find the scar wax easy to use, moldable, and blendable, often praising it as beginner-friendly.
Several reviewers report the advertised spatula was missing from their order, though one notes the seller replaced the set after a complaint.
Reviewers describe the product as fun to work with and effective for fake wounds and scars, with some noting a little goes a long way.
A few reviewers mention the wax is sticky or difficult to work with, especially on high-movement areas, and can be hard to remove from clothing.
Some reviewers note a learning curve or need for extra aids like Vaseline or lotion to make the wax easier to mold and apply.
